overview: H-E-B is a leading Texas-based supermarket chain with over 350 locations. The Assortment Tool project aimed to give buyers and analysts better insight into the cost, value, and impact of shelf decisions—moving from gut feel to data-driven actions.

sections.label: The Challenge
sections.headline: Shelf decisions were driven by gut feel, not data.
sections.subheading: Category managers were working in the dark:

cards.text: Fragmented systems made ROI analysis nearly impossible for buyers.
Assortment updates frequently led to costly missteps or poor store alignment.
Manual processes slowed speed-to-shelf and hindered competitive response.

cards.title: Speed to shelf
cards.description: Reduce the time from decision to store implementation dramatically.

cards.title: Standardized processes
cards.description: Create consistent workflows across 350+ stores and all categories.

cards.title: Strategic innovation
cards.description: Enable data-driven decisions that improve profitability and competitive positioning.

subsections.title: Story Mapping & Research
paragraphs: We aligned stakeholders through story mapping and regular user charrettes. These research sprints built empathy and drove faster iteration across the complex ecosystem of H-E-B's 400+ internal tools.

subsections.title: Understanding Users
paragraphs: We designed for two core user types:

items: Business Development Managers (BDMs): Balance product mix and profitability across categories
Shelf Edge Analysts (SEAs): Tailor assortments for store performance and changing demand

features.name: Decision Tree
features.headline: Strategy meets science.
features.description: Evaluate item mix, demand patterns, and strategic fit through structured decision flows. Turn complex choices into clear, data-backed actions.

features.name: New Item Queue
features.headline: New products, sorted.
features.description: Prioritize and compare new vs existing items in a unified workflow. Make room for innovation without sacrificing proven performers.

features.name: Assortment Optimizer
features.headline: The perfect shelf, modeled.
features.description: Model and finalize item selection with optimization algorithms. See the impact of changes before committing to the shelf.

features.name: Shelf Edge Calendar
features.headline: Every change, planned.
features.description: View and manage all planning activities in one timeline. Coordinate across teams and never miss a reset window again.

sections.title: Analytics & Reporting
paragraphs: Users gained new visibility into assortment health, out-of-stocks, and ROI. Visual dashboards empowered better strategic planning and decision validation.

sections.title: Reflections
paragraphs: This project transformed how a key business function operated at H-E-B. By designing in sync with existing workflows and elevating user research, we delivered massive ROI and long-term usability improvements.

quotes.text: This flow is user friendly, attractive, and would provide real value by moving decision-making that was 'in the brain' onto paper.
quotes.author: BDM, Healthy Living

quotes.text: Being able to validate intuition with data across clusters is something I've never been able to do until now.
quotes.author: Buying Decision Manager

quotes.text: Looking at these metrics visually is already giving me insights. I think I could live in this tool all day.
quotes.author: Buying Decision Manager
